name: ETT: Electricity Transformer Temperature Dataset
description: The Electricity Transformer Temperature (ETT) dataset is a widely adopted benchmark for long-sequence time-series forecasting (LSTF). Collected from two counties in China over a two-year period (2016-2018), each record comprises target oil temperature and 6 power load features. Standard subsets include ETTh1, ETTh2 (1-hour resolution) and ETTm1, ETTm2 (15-minute resolution).
